data.title: Data Repository
data.body: The source of truth for your Work. It holds the metadata and content the platform maintains for you — for a directory that is every item, category and tag; for other Work types it is the structured content behind the pages. Agents write here first, and everything else is generated from it. It changes rarely and is safe to edit by hand.

work.title: Work Repository

The platform takes the Data Repository, applies your chosen Work template, and produces this repository — usually a deployable website or web app, but depending on the template it can be a mobile app, a docs site, or any other project. This is the repository that gets deployed.
